description: Read parquet via polars's lazy scanner with predicate + column pushdown.

path.label: Path / Glob
path.description: Local path, glob, or cloud URI (s3:// / gs:// / az://)

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Projection pushdown — only these columns are read off disk.

predicate.label: Predicate
predicate.description: SQL predicate pushed down to the parquet reader.

output_type.description: 'polars' (default) or 'pandas'. Auto-converts at boundary if pandas.
output_type.label: Output Type

streaming.description: Use polars streaming engine for out-of-core execution (frames larger than memory).
streaming.label: Streaming

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (sample rows) for builder UIs.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
